descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Color by Number in VR**

Dive into a relaxing, color-filled escape with Color-A-Cube, a cozy VR coloring game built around simple, satisfying interactions. Pick a voxel model, grab your virtual brush, and color it cube by cube with crisp clicks, happy pops, sparkling effects, and that “just one more cube” feeling. Easy to start and strangely hard to put down. Whether you play for a few minutes or settle in for a longer creative session, Color-A-Cube is designed to help you unwind at your own pace.
[media]


[media]
Start with over 100 voxel models to color, ranging from cozy scenes and fantasy creatures to landmarks, food creations, vehicles, seasonal surprises, and more.
[media]
 On top of that, Color-A-Cube adds a new free model every week, including seasonal content, special surprises, and crossover creations from other games.


[media]
Some models are more than just models. Color your way through playful mini-stories and evolving scenes, from seasonal dioramas to a dinosaur’s very dramatic journey from meteor impact to museum exhibit. Yes, really.
[media]


[media]
Still hungry for more cubes? Alongside the 100+ voxel models and weekly free additions, Color-A-Cube will also offer monthly themed DLC packs and an optional Color Pass that immediately unlocks all available DLC.
[media]
